blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Friday said former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV’s allegation that a company linked to Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband received more than P319 million from China warrants serious attention if backed by sufficient evidence. At a press conference, Trillanes said CALE88 Foods Corp., a food company partly owned by Atty. Mans Carpio, received hundreds of millions of pesos from China, which he said raised serious national security concerns. “Dapat kilabutan po tayo dito… Bawal po iyan. Bawal tumanggap from a foreign government, especially high-ranking official ang vice president,” he said. (We should be alarmed by this… This […]...
